## Checklist

- [ ] Linked issue/discussion (or this is a trivial fix)
- [ ] `ruff check .` and `pytest -q` pass (backend) / `npm run build` passes (frontend)
- [ ] Commits are signed off — `git commit -s` ([DCO](https://developercertificate.org/))
- [ ] Docs / CHANGELOG `Unreleased` updated if user-facing
- [ ] No secrets, phone numbers, or real chat data in the diff
